_comment: Ordered provider lanes, and within each an ordered model fallback list.
Model names live here and NEVER in code: free catalogues churn, and providers have been
observed silently deleting free models. A 404 falls through to the next entry and logs loudly.
rpm sits deliberately under the published ceiling - those numbers are not guaranteed and are
no longer documented per model. Session 3 replaces these with numbers measured from the quota
2026-08: gemini-2.5-flash-lite started returning 404 'no longer available to new users', which
is exactly the churn this ordered list exists for - the router fell through and kept working.
It stays last in the list because existing keys can still use it.
